title: The Great Green Wall's one of the world's most ambitious eco-projects. Is it working?
summary: It's a global effort with a multibillion dollar price tag. Among its aims: re-greening nearly 250 million acres, planting 4,000 miles of trees, helping farmers, creating jobs, sequestering carbon.
